title: Software Development Engineer
skills: Java, Spring Boot, SQL, Data Structures, REST APIs, Git
description:
About TechNova
TechNova builds cloud-native enterprise software for banks and government clients. Our platforms process 40 million transactions a day.

The role
You will join a product squad that designs, builds and runs Java microservices used by millions of citizens.

Responsibilities
• Build REST APIs and event-driven services with Spring Boot, MySQL and RabbitMQ
• Write clean, tested code and take part in design and code reviews
• Own features end to end: design, implementation, deployment on Kubernetes and monitoring
• Fix production issues together with the on-call engineer

What we look for
• Strong data structures, algorithms and OOP fundamentals
• Good SQL and an understanding of indexes and transactions
• At least one project that uses Java or another backend language

Good to have
• Docker, Kubernetes or any cloud platform
• Contributions to open source

Work mode: hybrid, 3 days a week in the Bengaluru office. No service bond.

family health cover, meal card, internet
